comments.author: Donce
comments.body:
Rollo Helm quest is 2nd in this quest chain, so after I discovered Rollo Helm I tried to get this quest because I was so sure that the first quest in chain, Vikings, was already done. I used about 50 QMP a couple of months ago - of course with no success. So I abandoned this Vinland quest for a while, until last week. I came to Stockholm once more and burned about 100 QMP's - no success again. On the other web site I've read that there are two different quests in London maritime guild with the same name Vikings so I came back to London, made the right Vikings quest and went to Stockholm. I used only 2 or 3 QMP and got this quest :)

Hope this will help someone to save their time and QMP :)

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Notice the numbers on the quest chain scrolls. Both Rollo's Helm and Vikings are listed as #1; this means they have no prerequisites (other than fame) to generate. Once you've done both of them, the entire Viking quest chain becomes available to you. (And for what it's worth, I did the Rollo's Helm quest well before Vikings.)
